Package dev.opencollab.paletter

Class PaletteReport

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.PaletteReport
public final class PaletteReport extends Object
Everything noteworthy that happened while compiling a palette: content left out for a version, anchors that matched nothing, fallbacks that were used. Each PaletteReport.Entry has a code to filter by and names the content it is about. The reports consumer of the Paletter gets every report; by default it logs them. A report never changes: a palette extended with a layer has a new report.
Since:
1.0.0

    • version

      public @NonNull DataVersion version()

    • unknownBlocks

      public @NonNull Set<BedrockBlockType> unknownBlocks()
      Lists the blocks this palette's version lacks and no specific fallback covers. A default fallback (Fallbacks.Builder#defaultBlock) does not count as covering them: they are what it is sent for. Blocks behind a disabled experiment are included. Only the palette compiled from the vanilla data and its layers has them; the one-entry notes handed to the reports consumer have none.
      Returns:
      the blocks of the newest canonical set that are missing, in canonical order
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • unknownItems

      public @NonNull Set<BedrockItemVariant> unknownItems()
      Lists the item variants this palette's version lacks and no specific fallback covers, so a missing aux variant is exact. A default fallback (Fallbacks.Builder#defaultItem) does not count as covering them. Items behind a disabled experiment and items removed with Paletter.Builder#removeItemTypes are included. Notes handed to the reports consumer have none.
      Returns:
      the item variants of the newest canonical set that are missing, in canonical order
      Since:
      1.0.0
